
### ‘‘slow start’’ later  {.smaller}


* heuristic: slow start if window size is ‘small’ compared to last packet loss 

   * compromise: find correct size v. overload network
 
<hr class="vspace" />
* method:
* set <code>ssthresh</code> = bytes in flight / 2 on packet loss
* use slow start when window size \< <code>ssthresh</code>
